Market today: Yields are screaming higher, hitting 2007 highs. This is the real driver, especially for your tech/chip heavy, leveraged book. It's the opposite of what you want to see.

Your holdings: SOXL (-58.57%) and SPAL (-35.07%) are flagged for attention. They're leveraged ETFs and are bleeding. QQQ (-0.81%), SMH (-14.06%), and QQQI (-3.96%) are also in the red and flagged for trim. CRWD (30.96%) and SPY (3.4%) are holding up.

Watch: The 10-year Treasury yield. If it keeps climbing, it's a major headwind.

Bottom line: High yields are the enemy right now, especially with your leveraged positions.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming further if it breaks below recent lows.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, watch for further downside.
No new buys today - hold and watch
